note: Ana and her family make a short neighborhood visit. Start at the station, locate the father at the bank and the mother at the pharmacy, find the children at the library, then meet at the mall and get food at the supermarket. Explicit Spanish transitions explain each change of location; the English stays within the early lesson’s scope. Bank is already in the current Unit 6.1. It was not found as a declared target in Units 1–5. Keep it in this rebuild; do not call it a newly added course word. Mall and supermarket are proposed additions. Do not assess a hidden errand from a generic building photo.

lesson.title: 6.1 Places Around Town
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
lesson.goal: Name useful places, locate familiar people, and connect a place with a familiar need.
